gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: In 2017, Syndicate 1084 reported a release of GBP 39.4 million in technical reserves from prior periods, representing a 2.15% reduction of its opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,830.6 million. This favorable development was primarily driven by the Energy and Marine Divisions and was attributed to favourable claims development on losses during 2017. The year also saw significant catastrophe events including Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, and Maria, two Mexican earthquakes, and California wildfires, which contributed to a total net ultimate claim estimate of GBP 99.3 million for these 2017 events. Prior year events from 2016, such as the Fort McMurray wildfire and the North Canterbury earthquake, also had ultimate claims of GBP 6.6 million each.

gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: In 2017 Syndicate 1084 recorded a release of prior year claims reserves of GBP 39.4m (a c.2.15% reduction relative to opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,830.6m). The releases were attributed predominantly to favourable claims development, particularly in the Energy and Marine divisions. The syndicate remains exposed to major 2017 catastrophes (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, Mexico earthquakes and California wildfires) which produced significant gross exposures (GBP 314.8m) and net exposure (c.GBP 102.8m; c.GBP 99.3m after reinstatement adjustments). Prior-year 2016 events of note include the Fort McMurray wildfire and the North Canterbury earthquake, each with modest ultimate claim estimates.

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Technical Reserves table (explicit). Prior year development taken from the explicit narrative 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding'. Some per-line reserve movements are not quantified in the report; LOB attributions (Energy, Marine) are stated qualitatively. Aggregate 2017 catastrophe figures are given as combined gross/net amounts; where the report gives multiple net figures (net and net after reinstatement) the reduced post-reinstatement net (GBP 99.3m) was used for syndicate net loss reference. Percentages in gross premium mix rounded to two decimal places.
